heading.text: meritNAMA: charcoal + aurora, violet glow, colour only in the data

colours.text:
Language:

Charcoal pages, an aurora header on every main page (navy, teal, slate, amber), one violet accent that glows on active items and main buttons.
Colour in the data only:
Green = safe, fell, accepted
Amber = target, estimate, waiting
Coral = reach, rose, rejected
Cyan = information

Motion: drifting aurora, button sheen, live dots, lines that draw in, cards that lift on hover. All off under reduced motion.

pagemap.text:
Feels busy, not crowded:
live counts (viewing now, online), a ticker of what changed, avatars on reviews and follows, 'also shortlisted by', seat fill meters.

Photos: ward-at-night on Hospital, library group on Community, night study on Sign in, campus for the landing page.

adminNote.text:
Admin plan:

Today = cycle strip (PHF schedule), one 'Needs you' list sorted by urgency, a health row.

Data = one area, four tabs. Inductions: a checklist card per induction with ONE next-step button. Files: drop zone + list. Reference. Estimates.

Each file kind is one module (recognise, validate, strip personal fields, apply, summary). New kinds: schedule, revisions (amendments), joining status.

Estimates are built automatically when inputs land, never published without a click.

joinNote.text:
Induction 21 real figures (joining snapshot): 1,449 seats, round 8 allocated 1,219, joined 1,084, not joined 135, never filled 230 = 365 wasted (25%).

Joining status shows on the last round only, and on Candidates. Emails, phones and CNICs in the joining file are never stored.
